description: The only OpenRouter CLI built for fleet operations: budgets, anomaly alarms, and failover maps over a local usage ledger — not another chat wrapper.

novel_features.name: Models Query DSL
novel_features.description: Shortlist models by capability, price, and context window with a structured query over the synced catalog — offline and instant.

novel_features.name: Cost-by-Cron Rollup
novel_features.description: Attribute spend to the cron, agent, or lineage that incurred it, over any window.

novel_features.name: Cost Regression Alarm
novel_features.description: Flag per-model cost spikes against the trailing baseline before they compound.

novel_features.name: Per-Cron Budget Contract
novel_features.description: Set spend caps per cron or agent and enforce them pre-flight with typed exit codes.

novel_features.name: Providers Degraded Watch
novel_features.description: See which providers or models are currently degraded before dispatching work to them.

novel_features.name: Weekly-Cap ETA
novel_features.description: Project the date your key's spend cap trips, from the observed burn rate.

novel_features.name: Endpoint Failover Map
novel_features.description: Rank the providers serving one model by status, price, and observed latency for dispatch order.

novel_features.name: Generation Cost Forensics
novel_features.description: Break one generation into its cost anatomy: tokens, latency, and the delta versus the cheapest provider.

novel_features.name: Free-Tier and Cap Headroom
novel_features.description: One view of current headroom: key-cap remaining, free-tier daily quota, and today's free-model burn.

novel_features.name: Credits Runway
novel_features.description: Project days-to-zero for prepaid credits at the trailing burn rate — the 402 leading indicator.

novel_features.name: Ledger Reconcile
novel_features.description: Verify the local usage mirror against upstream daily totals and flag days that disagree.

novel_features.name: Catalog Churn Watch
novel_features.description: See what changed in the model catalog between syncs: additions, removals, and repricings with deltas.
